notes: The spec's /audio/translations example verbatim. Recordable with real audio. The upload, german.m4a, is 4.7 s of German speech ("Hallo, mein Name ist Wolfgang und ich komme aus Deutschland. Wohin fährst du heute?", the spec example's sentence in German) generated for this suite with espeak-ng 1.51 (voice de, 185 words a minute) and encoded with ffmpeg (AAC in an M4A container, 16 kHz mono, metadata stripped, bit-exact): synthetic, so free of licence terms. The same file is in every case that names it; a real recording of a person may replace it.
